Para obter sua chave de API do SendIt
1. Faça login no seu [Painel SendIt dashboard](https://sendit.infiniteappsai.com/dashboard)
2. Vá para **Configurações > Chaves de API**
3. Clique em **Criar chave de API** — a chave é mostrada apenas uma vez, então copie-a imediatamente
4. Cole a chave abaixo (ela começa com `sk_live_`)

Select one or more social media platform: Selecione uma ou mais plataformas de mídia social para publicar. Certifique-se de que suas contas estão conectadas no painel do SendIt em **Configurações > Contas conectadas**.
The text content of your post. Character: The text content of your post. Character limits vary by platform (e.g. X: 280, or more with X Premium; LinkedIn: 3000; Instagram: 2200).
A public https:// URL to an image (JPG,: A public https:// URL to an image (JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP) or video (MP4, MOV). **Required for Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok and YouTube.** Images must be under 10 MB and videos under 100 MB.
Add multiple public https:// image URLs: Add multiple public https:// image URLs to create a carousel post. Supported on Instagram and Threads. Add one URL per item.
Leave as **Auto-detect** unless SendIt m: Leave as **Auto-detect** unless SendIt misidentifies your media. Choose **Image** or **Video** to force a specific type. Only sent when media is attached.
Optional title, used by platforms that s: Optional title, used by platforms that support one (e.g. YouTube, Pinterest, Reddit-style communities).
Optional comment SendIt posts right afte: Optional comment SendIt posts right after the post on platforms that support it (e.g. Instagram, LinkedIn).
Optional advanced settings keyed by plat: Optional advanced settings keyed by platform, e.g. `{"pinterest": {"boardId": "123"}}`. Leave empty for defaults.
Optional value for the Idempotency-Key h: Optional value for the Idempotency-Key header. Leave empty to use one generated from this flow run and step. Note: in testing SendIt did not reject repeated schedule requests with the same key.
When to publish the post. Must be in the: Quando publicar o post. Deve ser no futuro. Os tempos são interpretados em UTC — converta o seu horário local, se necessário.
Select the scheduled post you want to ac: Selecione a postagem agendada que você deseja agir. Apenas postagens com status de **Pendente** são listadas.
Maximum accounts to return (1-100). Empt: Maximum accounts to return (1-100). Empty uses the SendIt default.
Only return scheduled posts for a specif: Só retornar posts agendados para uma plataforma específica. Deixe em branco para ver todas as plataformas.
Platform to get analytics for. SendIt di: Platform to get analytics for. SendIt disables analytics for X.
Only posts published on or after this da: Only posts published on or after this date.
Only posts published on or before this d: Only posts published on or before this date.
Optional status filter as SendIt reports: Optional status filter as SendIt reports it (e.g. pending).
The schedule ID returned by Schedule Pos: The schedule ID returned by Schedule Post or listed by List Scheduled Posts (field id).
Lowercase SendIt platform value, e.g. x,: Lowercase SendIt platform value, e.g. x, linkedin, instagram, threads, bluesky, tiktok, youtube, telegram, discord.
